description: WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) of 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST at :3766-3784 - the CUSTDAT miss, and the SECOND of this program's two dead guards. case06 owns the first. Same class of defect, a different guard, a statement-ordering quirk the sibling arms do not have, and - because the flag this arm raises is a different flag - an outcome that is NOT case06's mirror image everywhere a reader would expect it to be. THE DEAD GUARD. 9000-READ-ACCT at :3608-3644 is a guard chain, and it guards its FINAL step with IF DID-NOT-FIND-CUST-IN-CUSTDAT GO TO 9000-READ-ACCT-EXIT at :3636-3638. DID-NOT-FIND-CUST-IN-CUSTDAT is an 88-level on WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :501-502 whose VALUE is the literal 'Did not find associated customer in master file', so the guard fires only if WS-RETURN-MSG holds exactly that text. 9400's NOTFND arm never puts it there: the statement SET DID-NOT-FIND-CUST-IN-CUSTDAT TO TRUE at :3769 IS COMMENTED OUT - an asterisk in column 7, re-inspected character by character because the entire case rests on it - and the arm instead composes a DIFFERENT text by STRING at :3773-3783. THE GUARD AT :3636 THEREFORE NEVER FIRES, and :3642-3643 PERFORMS 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA, which stores an ACUP-OLD-DETAILS snapshot whose customer half comes from a CUSTOMER-RECORD that no read ever filled and copies that record's name fields into CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, -MNAME and -LNAME at :3807-3809. This case encodes that continuation. A case that expected an early exit here would be asserting a program this repository does not contain, and practice B5 requires the expectation reproduce the odd thing the COBOL does rather than the tidy thing a corrected program would do. THE STATEMENT-ORDERING QUIRK, which distinguishes this arm from both its siblings. 9400 performs MOVE WS-RESP-CD TO ERROR-RESP and MOVE WS-REAS-CD TO ERROR-RESP2 at :3770-3771, BEFORE the IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF test at :3772. 9200 does those two moves INSIDE its guarded block at :3671-3673 and 9300 does the same at :3720-3722. Behaviourally the two moves happen UNCONDITIONALLY here, so ERROR-RESP and ERROR-RESP2 are overwritten even on a path where no message is composed. Nothing on THIS path observes the difference - the guard is open, so the message is composed either way - and the ordering is recorded rather than normalised because normalising the three arms into one shape is exactly the tidying B5 forbids. THE COMPOSED MESSAGE, operand by operand, all DELIMITED BY SIZE so each contributes its full declared width: 'CustId:' (7, :3774), WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X (9, the PIC X(09) redefinition at :379-380), ' not found' (10, :3776 - and note there is NO trailing 'in', unlike 9200's and 9300's ' not found in' at :3677 and :3726), ' in customer master.Resp: ' (26, :3777 - ONE space after the colon AND a trailing space before the operand, where 9300's ' Acct Master file.Resp:' has neither and 9200's ' Cross ref file.  Resp:' has two spaces INSIDE it and none after), ERROR-RESP (10, :401), ' REAS:' (6, :3779 - UPPER CASE, where both siblings write ' Reas:' at :3680 and :3729) and ERROR-RESP2 (10, :405). Each of the three literals was copied out of its own source line rather than adapted from a sibling. 7+9+10+26+10+6+10 is 78 characters into a PIC X(75) receiver, so the receiver fills and the last three characters are lost - seven of ERROR-RESP2's ten survive as '0000000'. The two response codes are not case data and cannot drift: a keyed miss reports no CICS RESP, so the fallback is DFHRESP(NOTFND) = FileStatus.NOTFND = 13 with RESP2 = 0, and MOVE WS-RESP-CD PIC S9(09) COMP TO ERROR-RESP PIC X(10) renders nine unsigned digits left justified with one pad space, giving '000000013 ' and '000000000 ' - which is why TWO spaces separate the digits from ' REAS:'. :2981 then MOVEs the 75 characters into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), appending three. THE SECOND CONSEQUENCE, and where this case stops resembling case06. The flag 9400 raises at :3768 is FLG-CUSTFILTER-NOT-OK, not FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK, and 9400's NORMAL arm at :3764-3765 is the only place FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER is ever set on this path. It is not reached, so :2577-2579 does NOT set ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION STAYS ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED. Three order-sensitive EVALUATEs then land on arms case06 never touches, and all three were DERIVED rather than assumed. 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS at :2698-2725 takes its ELSE because the context is REENTER and, CC-ACCT-ID-N being non-zero, its inner ELSE at :2706-2707 echoes CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO as 00000000001 - the account the operator asked for is still shown, and it was found; but the EVALUATE at :2710-2724 now lands on WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2711, so 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES runs and 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES never does. 3201 at :2732-2780 MOVEs LOW-VALUES to forty-two items - sixteen account and twenty-six customer - so every detail field on the screen is LOW-VALUES even though the account record WAS read successfully and its values sit in ACUP-OLD-ACCT-DATA. That is the sharpest observable consequence of the missing customer row: a found account is not displayed. 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG at :2957-2977 lands on WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2960 rather than WHEN ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :2962, so PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS is set - WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) holding the 39-character literal at :468-469 - which :2979 MOVEs into INFOMSGO PIC X(45) right-space-padded to 45. And the cursor EVALUATE at :3009-3167 falls all the way through to WHEN OTHER at :3165-3166, not to the third arm case06 reaches: FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA at :3010 is false because WS-INFO-MSG holds the search-key prompt, NO-CHANGES-DETECTED at :3011 is false because WS-RETURN-MSG holds the composed error, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :3013 and FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK at :3014 are both false because :1814-1816 set FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID and nothing since has changed it, and every remaining arm tests a WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS item whose NOT-OK value is '0' and whose BLANK value is 'B' (:192-345) while INITIALIZE at :866-868 left them SPACES and 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS returned at :1446 without editing one of them. WHEN OTHER moves -1 into ACCTSIDL, so the cursor lands on the same field as case06's by a different route, and saying which route is the point. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor. THE FLAG THAT NOTHING READS - the finding that makes this case worth shipping. FLG-CUSTFILTER-NOT-OK is WRITTEN at exactly two sites, :3768 and :3787, and is READ NOWHERE in the presentation logic. The colour section at :3170-3192 tests only FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :3176 and FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK at :3180, so neither fires. All thirty-nine CSSETATY expansions from :3208 to :3432 were enumerated by their (TESTVAR1) substitution - ACCT-STATUS, OPEN-YEAR, OPEN-MONTH, OPEN-DAY, CRED-LIMIT, EXPIRY-YEAR, EXPIRY-MONTH, EXPIRY-DAY, CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT, REISSUE-YEAR, REISSUE-MONTH, REISSUE-DAY, CURR-BAL, CURR-CYC-CREDIT, CURR-CYC-DEBIT, EDIT-US-SSN-PART1, -PART2, -PART3, DT-OF-BIRTH-YEAR, -MONTH, -DAY, FICO-SCORE, FIRST-NAME, MIDDLE-NAME, LAST-NAME, ADDRESS-LINE-1, STATE, ADDRESS-LINE-2, ZIPCODE, CITY, COUNTRY, PHONE-NUM-1A, -1B, -1C, PHONE-NUM-2A, -2B, -2C, PRI-CARDHOLDER and EFT-ACCOUNT-ID - and NOT ONE of them is CUSTFILTER. They are skipped in any event, because :3186-3189 GO TOes 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT on ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED. So NO field on this screen carries DFHRED and NO field carries the '*' marker: the customer-master failure is completely INVISIBLE in the attribute planes even though the error text names it. The intuitive expectation - that a customer-filter failure reddens the customer-side fields the way an account-filter failure reddens ACCTSIDO - is wrong, and it is wrong twice over, once because no CSSETATY site tests that flag and once because the expansions never execute. Every colour is therefore the default DFHDFCOL and every highlight the default DFHDFHI, both x'00' exactly as MOVE LOW-VALUES at :2669 left them, except the information line: 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS at :3567-3571 finds WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE false - there IS a message - and moves DFHBMASB, a field attribute drawn from a different section of DFHBMSCA than the item's own plane, which is reproduced rather than normalised. FKEY05 and FKEY12 stay hidden because :3573 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE and :3578 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION. The xxxA items 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS writes, and the DFHBMFSE :2996 moves into ACCTSIDA on the ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED arm of :2993-3006, are deliberately NOT declared: they are items of the input redefine CACTUPAI, not of the sent CACTUPAO. THE UNREAD CUSTOMER RECORD, and the convention this case uses. CUSTOMER-RECORD is COPY CVCUS01Y at :646, its own 01 group in WORKING-STORAGE and not among the three areas INITIALIZE names at :866-868, so it exists whether or not a read filled it and holds what COBOL leaves in an uninitialised group: SPACES in every PIC X span and ZERO in every numeric one. That is the convention adopted here, it is the same one case06 adopted for the account side, and it is chosen because it is what the read-outcome contract already implies rather than because it is convenient - common.FileStatus publishes the outcome vocabulary and customer.CustomerRepository.ReadResult is a DISCRIMINATED OUTCOME (found, notFound, or a status) that returns to its caller and never decides to abend on the caller's behalf, so a missed EXEC CICS READ INTO(CUSTOMER-RECORD) leaves the receiving group untouched rather than absent, unfilled rather than null. THE FINGERPRINT of the 9500 run that should not have happened, and it is asserted where the model can see it - in the navigation image, because ACUP-OLD-DETAILS is not a dataset but WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, which COMMON-RETURN at :1010-1013 places immediately after the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. The resulting snapshot is ASYMMETRIC and the asymmetry is the observable behaviour, the exact mirror of case06's: the ACCOUNT half is populated from the real row - ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID-X 00000000001, ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N 194.00, ACUP-OLD-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 2020.00, ACUP-OLD-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 1020.00, ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N and ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N 0.00, all five at scale exactly 2, the open date split by :3832-3834 into 2014, 11 and 20, the expiry date by :3837-3839 into 2025, 05 and 20, the reissue date by :3843-3845 into 2025, 05 and 20, and ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID ten spaces - while the CUSTOMER half is the allocated state: ACUP-OLD-CUST-ID-X nine zeros, ACUP-OLD-CUST-SSN-X nine zeros, the three names twenty-five spaces each, the three address lines fifty spaces each, ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-YEAR four and -MON and -DAY two spaces each, ACUP-OLD-CUST-FICO-SCORE-X three zeros, and the two phone numbers, the government identifier, the EFT account and the primary-holder indicator all blank. Those values are stated here rather than pinned as a record because this model compares the shared image only. What IS pinned is the part of the snapshot 9500 copies into the commarea, and it carries the fingerprint: :3805 MOVEs the real ACCT-ID so CDEMO-ACCT-ID reads 00000000001 and :3810 the real ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS so CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS reads Y, while :3806 REPLACES the CDEMO-CUST-ID that 9200's NORMAL arm had just correctly supplied at :3666 - 000000001, the identifier the cross-reference holds and the very key the failed read used - with the unread record's ZERO, and :3807-3809 WIPE the three carried customer names to spaces. CDEMO-CUST-ID reading as nine zeros after a cross-reference that supplied 000000001, in the same response that reports 00000000001 as a found account, IS the fingerprint, and it is the single strongest assertion in this case. The three names are carried INBOUND as Immanuel, Madeline and Kessler at their declared 25 precisely so the wipe is observable in four fields rather than one; that is safe rather than convenient, because CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, -MNAME and -LNAME are WRITE-ONLY in this program - :3807-3809 are their only occurrences in all 4,236 lines - and the inbound CDEMO-CUST-ID is dead, since 9200 at :3617 overwrites it at :3666 before :3631 reads it. CDEMO-CARD-NUM keeps the 9680294154603697 the cross-reference supplied and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT stays 1, and CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, -FROM-PROGRAM, -TO-TRANID, -TO-PROGRAM, -USER-ID, -USER-TYPE, -LAST-MAP and -LAST-MAPSET stay exactly as they arrived because only the PF03 arm at :944-950 writes them. THE PATH INTO THE READ, identical to case04's and case06's up to 9400. EIBCALEN is 1033 - 160 for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus 873 for WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false too: the ELSE at :887-892 restores both areas from DFHCOMMAREA. Because WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA is not stated here it arrives as this model's unstated default, which is what ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION being ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED means - the 88-level at :656-658 accepts LOW-VALUES and SPACES alike. The carried CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1, so CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is false and CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is true. AID DFHENTER passes the validity gate at :906-912 on its first disjunct, so the remap at :914-916 does nothing. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 lands on WHEN OTHER at :996 - :927 needs PFK03, :964-965 needs ENTER as well as unfetched details, :966-967 needs CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to be the menu, :979 and :980 need a changes state - and that arm performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP at :1051-1058 finds ACCTSIDI neither '*' nor SPACES and MOVEs it into CC-ACCT-ID and ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X, then :1060-1062 GO TOes its exit because the details are unfetched, so ACCTSIDI is the only received field there can be. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS at :1433-1449 edits ONLY the search key and MOVEs LOW-VALUES to ACUP-OLD-ACCT-DATA at :1438, and 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT at :1783-1817 finds CC-ACCT-ID numeric and CC-ACCT-ID-N non-zero, so its ELSE at :1814-1816 MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID to CDEMO-ACCT-ID and SETs FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID - the guard 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's first arm tests at :2573 before SETting WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :2574 and performing 9000-READ-ACCT at :2575. 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS also MOVEs LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, -NEXT-MAPSET and -NEXT-MAP at :1031-1033, which is why nextProgram is present here where case01's cold start leaves it absent. THE READ OUTCOMES, three call sites and two arms of gate G47 in ONE pass. 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT at :3654-3662 reads DATASET(LIT-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH) = CXACAIX with RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) and takes its NORMAL arm at :3665-3667, MOVEing XREF-CUST-ID 000000001 into CDEMO-CUST-ID and XREF-CARD-NUM 9680294154603697 into CDEMO-CARD-NUM; CXACAIX is an alternate-index PATH over the CCXREF base and is reached through the one CardXrefRepository's alternate-key finder, never a second table or a second repository (gate G45). The live guard that follows at :3620-3622 tests FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and does not fire. 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT at :3703-3711 then reads DATASET(LIT-ACCTFILENAME) = ACCTDAT with the same 11-byte RIDFLD, KEYLENGTH 11, INTO(ACCOUNT-RECORD) LENGTH 300 and takes NORMAL at :3714-3715, SETting FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER - which is where this case parts company with case06, whose ACCTDAT read is the one that misses. The dead guard at :3627-3629 does not fire either, for the ordinary reason that WS-RETURN-MSG is still spaces. :3631 MOVEs CDEMO-CUST-ID into WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID and 9400 at :3753-3761 reads DATASET(LIT-CUSTFILENAME) = CUSTDAT with a 9-byte RIDFLD INTO(CUSTOMER-RECORD) LENGTH 500 - and MISSES, which is the NOTFND arm of gate G47 on that call site, alongside the NORMAL arms of the other two in the same pass. The three EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD statements keep their source WHEN order - NORMAL, NOTFND, OTHER - exactly (gate G30). THE SEED, and how the miss is arranged without touching the oracle. Measured over the whole fixtures, every XREF-CUST-ID in cardxref.txt has a matching custdata.txt row, so a customer-master miss is impossible from the unmodified data and the case must curate. It curates by OMISSION ONLY and only in this fixture's own inputs: custdata.txt zero-based row 0 IS customer 000000001, the customer the successful cross-reference names, so CUSTDAT is seeded from fixture rows 1 through 49 - forty-nine rows of exactly 500 bytes, every one byte-identical to the fixture - and the target row is simply never seeded. No row's bytes are altered, nothing is derived, and app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt is not written to: the COBOL, copybook, BMS, JCL, CSD and data trees are the parity oracle and stay read-only (practice B3). CXACAIX and ACCTDAT are seeded from the COMPLETE unmodified fixtures, all 50 rows each, so the alternate-key finder and the account keyed read have to discriminate on their keys rather than return the only row present - and so that the first two reads genuinely succeed, which is what makes the third the only failure. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER, so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, before anything decodes a row, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16, risk R-F). Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. THE RECORD EXPECTATIONS. CXACAIX row 48 is pinned as four fields plus the complete 50-byte image, ending in FILLER PIC X(14) as fourteen spaces, and ACCTDAT row 0 as all thirteen app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy fields plus the complete 300-byte image, carrying the misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE verbatim and ending in FILLER PIC X(178) as one hundred and seventy-eight spaces; the five monetary fields are stated at scale exactly 2, decoded from the zoned overpunch '{' that closes each span and encodes a positive digit zero (gate G23). There is deliberately NO CUSTDAT row projection, because the row this case is about is the one that is not there and a projection would have to invent it; the assertion is made at dataset level instead, where CUSTDAT is pinned on the final-state channel at exactly 49 rows of 500 bytes - the positive statement that the file was opened, holds real records, and holds no record for 000000001. Field names are the copybook's verbatim and FILLER is an addressable span rather than a gap: pinning both the fields and the whole image is what makes the total width an assertion, and a record missing a FILLER is short by exactly that span (gates G19 and G21). NOTHING IS WRITTEN. COACTUPC's write verbs are the read-for-update and REWRITE pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING at :3888-4105, which only the PF05 confirmation arm at :2602-2605 reaches, so expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion and the three seeded datasets are pinned unchanged on the final-state channel as the other half of it. RETURN CODE 0: COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not occur anywhere in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. expectedMessages is EMPTY, and that is deliberate rather than incidental. Only ONE error text is produced on this path - first-message-wins, because every message write in this program is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, :2574 SET it off, 9200 and 9300 both succeeded and added nothing, and 9400's NOTFND arm consumed it at :3772 - and that one text is asserted byte-exactly where the program actually put it, in ERRMSGO at its declared 78, beside INFOMSGO at its declared 45. It is not repeated in expectedMessages, because MessageChannel publishes DISPLAY_LINE, WS_MESSAGE_80 and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 and this path emits no DISPLAY and no SEND-PLAIN-TEXT at all; an entry there would assert an emission that never happened. THE NEXT TARGET is COACTUPC / COACTUP / CACTUPA, from :1031-1033 and :3591-3592, and the termination is RETURN_TRANSID from :1015-1018 - never XCTL, because the only XCTL in this program is in the PF03 arm at :956-959 which this path does not reach. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none is held server side - inbound the 1033-byte EIBCALEN, the AID, the sixteen carried CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields and one received map field; outbound the sixteen navigation fields. A DOCUMENTED SOURCE ODDITY, recorded without being asserted: DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-CARDXREF is declared TWICE under WS-RETURN-MSG with two DIFFERENT values, at :497-498 and :513-514, and neither is ever SET anywhere in COACTUPC, so no case in this folder may assert either text and this one does not. Both declarations are left exactly as written; tidying either would be an unrequested behaviour change (practice B5). TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') in ABEND-ROUTINE at :4203-4226 is not reached, because a NOTFND is an outcome the program handles rather than a condition it abends on. G51 is honoured by unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO: account.AccountUpdateController is constructed directly with fixture-backed repositories and its handler called as a plain method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP anywhere in the path. G15 and G18 place this case seventh of the twenty this program owns, and the module is not complete until the diff count is zero across all twenty. PROVENANCE (practice B12). Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of the exact lines named - :178-345, :368-406, :455-525, :620-780, :856-1075, :1430-1475, :1780-1825, :2556-2790, :2786-2990, :2986-3215, :3560-3600 and :3600-3890, with :3636 and :3769 inspected individually and :3769 character by character to confirm the asterisk in column 7 - and by DECODING the named fixture rows against the named copybook offsets, CVACT03Y at 50 and CVACT01Y at 300, cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the titles in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the highlight rule in app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, the file definitions in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD and the real data in app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt, custdata.txt and cardxref.txt. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL. Executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A of the migration plan rather than silently absorbed. Every record image and every screen value here is US-ASCII, named explicitly on the request and never taken from a platform default (practice B8), the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59 which is this source revision's own timestamp so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach (practice B7), and every collection is ordered so a reader can follow it against the source (practice B7). No user-specified rule governs this fixture - review_rules returns exactly 'No user rules provided' - so the practices cited throughout are the enterprise-standard substitutes the migration plan records, not invented rules, and their absence is not treated as licence to assert less. One authoring note: COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, and allocates its own case07 to a different scenario; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - the CUSTDAT miss whose guard cannot fire - is what this case is specified to pin.

fields.INFOMSGO: Enter or update id of account to update
fields.ERRMSGO: CustId:000000001 not found in customer master.Resp: 000000013  REAS:0000000
